serialization: UTF-8 JSON; keys lexicographically sorted; separators comma/colon without spaces; ensure_ascii=false; allow_nan=false; no BOM or trailing newline; all payload numbers are integers

id_ordering.boundary_edge_ids: ascending numeric unique; boundary_edges paired by matching edge ID
id_ordering.boundary_edge_endpoints: native unordered edge endpoints ascending, copied from E_FINAL
id_ordering.boundary_loop: Exact previous topology-audit ordering, start/end v36; first vertex repeated once; direction not reselected

hash_payload_definitions.combined: canonical full authority object excluding combined_authority_hash only

mismatch_policy: FAIL_CLOSED; no selector regeneration, inferred weight inheritance or implicit remapping
id_mapping_scope: Frozen native topology/vertex/face/edge IDs; any changed ID mapping requires separately approved authority reconciliation
